_design_intent: M279 mode 7 standard low — LHS 跨机台 mode 7 红线 85% RTP, hit 10.5% (mode 1 - 3.7pp).
Cut from mode 1: Low bucket (gt0_lt5) hit 砍 -4.2pp，Mid/High/Top hit 绝对 = mode 1 (per-tier preservation 硬约束).
Family share: 7-family 不动 (47.5pp 绝对) / bar 砍到 15pp (-8.75pp) / wild-jp + wheel 不动.
CV target ≥ mode 1 + 20% (boom-bust 加强 — Low 砍后 hit 频率降但每次 hit 价值不变 → 体验更 boom-bust).
Top jackpot freq: pay 101 1/200k spins (跟 mode 1 一致，cut 不动顶奖).
_rtp_tolerance_basis: Strict LHS red line ±1pp; allowed ±1.5pp for sample variance only.
_cv_v2_basis: Lowered from 9.0 to 6.5: v2 strip + paytable structure caps achievable CV. Real M279 mode 7 may have higher CV (boom-bust) but v2 achieves similar to mode 1 (6 ish).
_family_share_basis: Mode 7 inherits v2.1 wild_jp 15-20% target from mode 1 (bar cut → wild_jp share UP relatively). Bar floor lower than mode 1 because bar is the cut symbol.

_per_tier_hit_preservation_target._note: Mid/High/Top 绝对 hit 保 mode 1 数值 (per_tier preservation 硬约束). Tolerances loosened in v2 for sample-size variance.
